ns2:course.label: Voice
ns2:course.description: Instruction in voice at the advanced undergraduate and graduate level. (Summer session, 1 or 2 undergraduate or graduate hours.) May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. 2 or 3 undergraduate hours, or 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Primarily for music majors, junior standing and above. Passing of an audition is required prior to initial registration in any applied music course as approved by the faculty of the appropriate applied music division.
